Peste des Petit Ruminant virus (PPRV) is the causative agent of Peste des Petitis Ruminants (PPR) and the disease is characterized by a 100% case fatality in young lambs.

understanding the mechanism by which PPRV interacts with cellular receptors and the impact on host immunity, which may be helpful to develop effective vaccines and therapeutics.

SLAM and Nectin 4 are the two receptors for PPRV, and the virus induces immunosuppression through the activation of the PI3K/AKT/mTOR pathway.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the PPR virus has the ability to evade the host immune system by interacting with the cellular receptors.

the virus exploits host immune system for its survival and propagation, which needs to be understood in detail for the development of an effective vaccine and control measures.
